evidence: Labeled Tests; updates the test framework data generator in `test/functional/rpc_getblockstats.py` and its test fixture data.
rationale: Fixes an issue where running `rpc_getblockstats.py --gen-test-data` fails on builds configured without the wallet (`-DENABLE_WALLET=OFF`) (#31838). While this resolves a legitimate failure when regenerating test data without wallet support compiled in, running test fixture generation is an infrequent developer task.
